No — the `repo_read` tool cannot open that path.

**Capability boundary:** `repo_read` only accepts repository-relative paths within the current repository being worked on. It has no access to arbitrary host filesystem paths such as `C:/licenses/ink.txt`, which lies outside the repository tree entirely. None of the other available tools (build, edit, find, tests, git) provide general host filesystem access either — they all operate strictly within the scope of the repository or its test/build/version-control tooling.

If `ink.txt` is meant to be part of the repository, it would need to be added there and referenced by its repo-relative path for `repo_read` to access it.
